Por favor, diríjase a la configuración de su cuenta dentro de la aplicación para asegurarse de que esta función esté desactivada y así evitar futuros cargos automáticos. Si tiene más preguntas o necesita ayuda con su cuenta, háganoslo saber. Saludos cordiales, Soporte de Nebula
localised.empathetic: Entiendo que le preocupan los cargos inesperados que aparecen en su cuenta. Para detener estos pagos automáticos, por favor vaya a la configuración de su cuenta en la aplicación y desactive la función de recarga automática. Esto garantizará que no se produzcan más recargas. Si necesita ayuda para encontrar esta configuración, háganoslo saber.
localised.concise: Para detener los cargos automáticos, desactive la función de recarga automática en la configuración de su cuenta. Esto evitará que su saldo se recargue automáticamente. Póngase en contacto con nosotros si necesita más ayuda.

drafts.formal: Hello, thank you for reaching out to us regarding the charges on your account. According to our policy, auto-refill is a feature that automatically tops up your balance until it is manually deactivated in your account settings. Please navigate to your account settings within the application to ensure that this feature is disabled to prevent further automatic charges. If you have any further questions or require assistance with your account, please let us know. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: I understand that you are concerned about unexpected charges appearing on your account. To stop these automatic payments, please go to your account settings in the app and deactivate the auto-refill feature. This will ensure that no further top-ups occur. If you need any help finding these settings, please let us know.
drafts.concise: To stop automatic charges, please deactivate the auto-refill feature in your account settings. This will prevent your balance from being topped up automatically. Please contact us if you need further assistance.

drafts.summary: The customer is reporting an unauthorized charge of $1,299 MXN after interacting with a prize wheel feature in the app. They are requesting a refund and expressing significant frustration.
drafts.citation_quote: Once we receive your message, we’ll investigate thoroughly.

localised.formal: Estimado/a usuario/a, lamento saber sobre el cargo inesperado que encontró después de usar la función de la rueda de premios. Para solucionar esto, por favor contacte a nuestro equipo de soporte directamente a través de la aplicación Nebula tocando el icono de engranaje en la esquina superior derecha y seleccionando Ayuda y soporte. Incluya una descripción del problema y una captura de pantalla de la transacción para que podamos investigar esto a fondo. De acuerdo con nuestro proceso, revisaremos los detalles y le asistiremos con los siguientes pasos. Saludos cordiales, Soporte de Nebula
localised.empathetic: Lamento mucho saber que se le cobraron $1,299 MXN después de interactuar con la rueda de premios en nuestra aplicación. Entiendo lo molesto que es ver un cargo inesperado cuando esperaba un premio. Por favor, comuníquese con nuestro equipo de soporte a través de la sección de Ayuda y soporte en la configuración de su aplicación para que podamos investigar qué sucedió. Una vez que proporcione una descripción y una captura de pantalla de la transacción, nuestro equipo podrá revisar esto por usted.
localised.concise: Por favor, contacte a nuestro equipo de soporte a través de la sección de Ayuda y soporte en la configuración de su aplicación para informar sobre este cargo. Incluya una descripción del problema y una captura de pantalla de la transacción para que podamos investigar. Revisaremos los detalles y le asistiremos más una vez que se reciba la solicitud.

drafts.formal: Hello, I am sorry to hear about the unexpected charge you encountered after using the prize wheel feature. To address this, please contact our support team directly through the Nebula app by tapping the gear icon in the top-right corner and selecting Help and Support. Please include a description of the issue and a screenshot of the transaction so that we may investigate this thoroughly. According to our process, we will review the details and assist you with the next steps. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: I am sorry to hear that you were charged $1,299 MXN after interacting with the prize wheel in our app. I understand how upsetting it is to see an unexpected charge when you were expecting a prize. Please reach out to our support team through the Help and Support section in your app settings so we can investigate what happened. Once you provide a description and a screenshot of the transaction, our team will be able to look into this for you.
drafts.concise: Please contact our support team through the Help and Support section in your app settings to report this charge. Include a description of the issue and a screenshot of the transaction so we can investigate. We will review the details and assist you further once the request is received.

drafts.summary: The customer is reporting an unexpected charge of over $60 after cancelling a $2.99 trial and is requesting a refund. The agent needs to determine the platform of purchase to guide the customer on refund requests and verify their subscription status.
drafts.citation_quote: If you subscribed or started a free trial via the App Store, refund requests are handled directly by Apple.
drafts.formal: Hello, Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the charge on your account. According to our policy, refund routing depends on where the subscription was originally purchased. If you subscribed via the Apple App Store, you must request a refund directly through Apple. If you subscribed through Google Play or our website, please provide your payment screenshot, the last four digits of your card, your country of residence, and the email used during registration so that we may assist you further. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: It sounds like you were surprised by a charge of over $60 after you had already cancelled your trial. To help you with your refund request, I first need to know which platform you used to sign up. If you purchased through the App Store, please contact Apple directly as they handle those requests. If you used Google Play or our website, please send us your payment screenshot, the last four digits of your card, your country, and your registration email so we can look into this for you.
drafts.concise: Please let me know if you subscribed via the App Store, Google Play, or our website. If you used the App Store, you must request a refund directly from Apple. For other platforms, please provide a payment screenshot, your registration email, your country, and the last four digits of your card.

drafts.summary: The customer denies signing up for a subscription and reports multiple charges. They are requesting cancellation and are concerned about a fee displayed when attempting to cancel.
drafts.citation_quote: If these instructions don’t work for you or you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact our support team, and we will be happy to assist you!
drafts.formal: Hello, Thank you for reaching out regarding your account charges. To assist you in locating your account and investigating these charges, please provide a screenshot of your payment, the last 4 digits of your card, the BIN (first 6 digits), your country of residence, and the email address used during registration. These details are required by our support team as outlined in our help documentation. Once you provide this information, we will be able to review your account status. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: I am sorry to hear about the unexpected charges you have seen on your account. To help us look into this and stop any further billing, please send us a screenshot of your payment, the last 4 digits of your card, the BIN (first 6 digits), your country of residence, and the email address you used to register. We will use these details to locate your account and assist you further. Please provide this information so we can address this for you.
drafts.concise: Please provide a screenshot of your payment, the last 4 digits of your card, the BIN (first 6 digits), your country of residence, and the email used during registration. We need these details to locate your account and investigate the charges. Once provided, we will assist you with your request.

drafts.summary: The customer is disputing an unexpected charge of 29.99€ after purchasing a 5€ reading. They are requesting a full refund and expressed dissatisfaction with a previous offer of a 50% partial refund.
drafts.citation_quote: Please report the issue using the “Contact Us” option on our app or by submitting a request directly from the Help Center.

localised.formal: Olá, obrigado por entrar em contato a respeito da divergência em suas cobranças. Observe que nossa Equipe de Suporte analisa todas as questões de faturamento para resolvê-las o mais rápido possível, conforme descrito em nossa documentação de ajuda. Para prosseguir com sua solicitação, envie uma consulta formal através da seção de Ajuda e Suporte do seu aplicativo ou via nossa Central de Ajuda. Inclua seu nome, data de nascimento, a data e hora da transação e uma descrição do problema. Investigaremos o assunto posteriormente. Atenciosamente, Suporte Nebula
localised.empathetic: Sinto muito saber que você foi cobrado 29.99€ quando esperava apenas um pagamento de 5€. É importante que analisemos essa cobrança inesperada para você imediatamente. Entre em contato com nossa equipe de suporte pelo aplicativo ou pela nossa Central de Ajuda para que possamos revisar os detalhes da sua conta. Assim que você fornecer seu nome, data de nascimento e os detalhes da transação, nossa equipe investigará isso para você. Atenciosamente, Suporte Nebula
localised.concise: Envie uma solicitação através da seção de Ajuda e Suporte do seu aplicativo ou da nossa Central de Ajuda para relatar esta cobrança. Inclua seu nome, data de nascimento e os detalhes da transação para que nossa equipe possa investigar. Analisaremos seu caso o mais rápido possível.

drafts.formal: Hello, thank you for reaching out regarding the discrepancy in your charges. Please note that our Support Team reviews all billing concerns to resolve them as quickly as possible, as outlined in our help documentation. To proceed with your request, please submit a formal inquiry through the Help and Support section of your app or via our Help Center. Please include your name, date of birth, the date and time of the transaction, and a description of the issue. We will then investigate the matter further. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: I am sorry to hear that you were charged 29.99€ when you only expected a 5€ payment. It is important that we look into this unexpected charge for you right away. Please contact our support team through the app or our Help Center so we can review your account details. Once you provide your name, date of birth, and the transaction details, our team will investigate this for you. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.concise: Please submit a request through the Help and Support section of your app or our Help Center to report this charge. Include your name, date of birth, and the transaction details so our team can investigate. We will review your case as quickly as possible.

drafts.summary: The customer reports an unexpected charge of 39 USD despite not having an active subscription visible in their account. They also state they have deleted their account but are still being charged.
drafts.citation_quote: Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription, trial or introductory offer.
drafts.formal: Hello, Please be advised that deleting the application does not cancel a subscription, as stated in our policy. To stop future charges, you must follow the specific cancellation process for the platform where the subscription was initiated. If you subscribed via the App Store, you must manage your cancellation directly through Apple. If you believe you were charged in error, please provide a screenshot of the payment, the last four digits of your card, your country of residence, and the email address used during registration so that we may investigate this further. Kind regards, Nebula Support
drafts.empathetic: It is concerning to see a charge of 39 USD when you do not believe you have an active subscription. Please know that deleting the app does not stop a subscription, which is why charges may have continued. To help us look into this, please send us a screenshot of the payment, the last four digits of your card, your country of residence, and the email address you used to register. We will then be able to assist you further.
drafts.concise: Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription, which is why you may still be charged. Please provide a screenshot of the payment, the last four digits of your card, your country of residence, and your registration email so we can investigate. We will assist you once these details are provided.
